code_summaries.application_init: The Application singleton resolves data paths, initializes DatabaseManager, and wires Repository, AuthService, and TripPlanner based on module availability.
code_summaries.database_lifecycle: DatabaseManager handles SQLite connections, PRAGMA setup, schema checks, recovery, rebuild flow, and aggregated errors or warnings.
code_summaries.csv_import: The CSV import pipeline normalizes headers, parses fields, and uses transactions plus upsert to load stadium and distance data reliably.
code_summaries.stadium_repository: StadiumRepository encapsulates stadium list queries, sorting, league filtering, single-item lookup, and administrator maintenance interfaces.
code_summaries.distance_repository: DistanceRepository normalizes undirected stadium-distance edges and provides query, adjacency lookup, and update interfaces.
code_summaries.auth_service: AuthService reads key.dat, checks magic and version, and validates administrator input locally with an XOR key.
code_summaries.trip_model: Trip stores route results, the current stop index, and the shopping cart so route browsing and purchasing can share one state model.
